description.value: Sea Raven Motel is the largest accommodation in Daajing Giids (Queen Charlotte) on Haida Gwaii, offering 30 rooms including ocean-view suites overlooking Skidegate Inlet. It sits within walking distance of local facilities and serves as a practical base for exploring the remote archipelago, including Gwaii Haanas National Park, wildlife watching, and kayaking. Pet-friendly ground-floor rooms are available for cyclists traveling with animals.

address.value: 3301 Oceanview Drive, Queen Charlotte, BC V0T 1S0
